story.text: 주말 오후, 선우는 나를 김해공항 근처 언덕으로 데려갔다. 이유는 묻지 않아도 뻔했다.
story.reading: ju-mal o-hu, seon-u-neun na-reul gim-hae-gong-hang geun-cheo eon-deok-eu-ro de-ryeo-gat-da. i-yu-neun mut-ji anh-a-do ppeon-haet-da.
story.en: Weekend afternoon, Sunwoo took me to a hill near Gimhae Airport. I didn't even need to ask why — it was obvious.

story.text: "오늘은 딱히 계획 없다. 그냥 여기서 여유롭게 시간 좀 보내자." 그가 돗자리를 펴며 말했다.
story.reading: "o-neul-eun ttak-hi gye-hoek eop-da. geu-nyang yeo-gi-seo yeo-yu-rop-ge si-gan jom bo-nae-ja." geu-ga dot-ja-ri-reul pyeo-myeo mal-haet-da.
story.en: "No particular plans today. Let's just spend some relaxed time here." He said, spreading out a picnic mat.

story.text: 그의 가방에서는 오래된 카메라가 나왔다. 비행기를 향한 그의 취미는 어릴 때부터 한결같았다.
story.reading: geu-ui ga-bang-e-seo-neun o-rae-doen ka-me-ra-ga na-wat-da. bi-haeng-gi-reul hyang-han geu-ui chwi-mi-neun eo-ril ttae-bu-teo han-gyeol-gat-at-da.
story.en: An old camera came out of his bag. His hobby of loving planes had stayed exactly the same since he was little.

story.text: 비행기가 낮게 지나갈 때마다 그는 셔터를 누르며 완전히 몰입했다. 그 순간만큼은 장난기 하나 없는 진지한 얼굴이었다.
story.reading: bi-haeng-gi-ga naj-ge ji-na-gal ttae-ma-da geu-neun syeo-teo-reul nul-leu-myeo wan-jeon-hi mol-ib-haet-da. geu sun-gan-man-keum jang-nan-gi ha-na eop-neun jin-ji-han eol-gul-i-eot-da.
story.en: Every time a plane flew by low, he pressed the shutter, completely absorbed. In that moment, his face was serious, without a trace of playfulness.

story.text: 나는 옆에서 그냥 하늘을 보며 빈둥거렸다. 딱히 뭘 하지 않아도 이상하게 마음이 편안했다.
story.reading: na-neun yeop-e-seo geu-nyang ha-neul-eul bo-myeo bin-dung-geo-ryeot-da. ttak-hi mwol ha-ji anh-a-do i-sang-ha-ge ma-eum-i pyeon-an-haet-da.
story.en: Beside him, I just lazed around looking up at the sky. Even doing nothing in particular, I strangely felt at ease.

story.text: "니는 요새 취미 뭐 있나?" 그가 카메라를 내려놓으며 불쑥 물었다. 나는 딱히 떠오르는 게 없어 웃기만 했다.
story.reading: "ni-neun yo-sae chwi-mi mwo it-na?" geu-ga ka-me-ra-reul nae-ryeo-noh-eu-myeo bul-ssuk mul-eot-da. na-neun ttak-hi tteo-o-reu-neun ge eop-seo us-gi-man haet-da.
story.en: "What hobbies do you even have these days?" He asked out of nowhere, setting down the camera. Nothing came to mind, so I just laughed.

story.text: "이렇게 아무 생각 없이 있는 것도 나쁘지 않네. 완전 재충전되는 기분이다." 그가 하늘을 보며 기지개를 켰다.
story.reading: "i-reo-ke a-mu saeng-gak eop-si it-neun geot-do na-ppeu-ji anh-ne. wan-jeon jae-chung-jeon-doe-neun gi-bun-i-da." geu-ga ha-neul-eul bo-myeo gi-ji-gae-reul kyeot-da.
story.en: "Being like this with no thoughts at all isn't bad either. Feels like I'm fully recharging." He said, stretching as he looked up at the sky.

story.text: "이번 챕터 단어랑 대화도, 여유롭게 하나씩 풀어봐라."
story.reading: "i-beon chaeb-teo dan-eo-rang dae-hwa-do, yeo-yu-rop-ge ha-na-ssik pul-eo-bwa-ra."
story.en: "Take this chapter's words and conversation too, one by one, at an easy pace."

words.example_en: I had a relaxed weekend for the first time in a while.
On weekends I just want to laze around at home.
He gets deeply absorbed in his hobby.
After traveling, both body and mind get recharged.

sentences.en: I enjoy a special hobby on weekends.
I spent a leisurely day for the first time in a while.

sentences.ko: 가끔은 아무것도 안 하고 빈둥거리는 것도 좋다.
sentences.reading: ga-kkeum-eun a-mu-geot-do an ha-go bin-dung-geo-ri-neun geot-do jo-ta
sentences.en: Sometimes it's good to just laze around and do nothing.

sentences.ko: 그는 비행기 사진에 완전히 몰입해 있었다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun bi-haeng-gi sa-jin-e wan-jeon-hi mol-ib-hae iss-eot-da
sentences.en: He was completely absorbed in taking photos of planes.
I rested well over the weekend and recharged.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 니는 요새 취미로 뭐 하나 있나?
turns.reading: ni-neun yo-sae chwi-mi-ro mwo ha-na it-na?
turns.en: Do you have any hobby these days?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 글쎄, 딱히 없는 것 같은데. 니처럼 이렇게 열정적인 거 하나도 없다.
turns.reading: geul-sse, ttak-hi eop-neun geot gat-eun-de. ni-cheo-reom i-reo-ke yeol-jeong-jeok-in geo ha-na-do eop-da.
turns.en: Hmm, I don't think I have one really. Nothing I'm as passionate about as you are with this.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 괜찮다, 천천히 찾으면 된다. 급할 거 없다 아이가.
turns.reading: gwaen-chan-ta, cheon-cheon-hi chaj-eu-myeon doen-da. geup-hal geo eop-da a-i-ga.
turns.en: It's fine, you can find one slowly. No need to rush.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Since when have you liked planes this much?

dialogues.question: 선우가 취미를 아직 못 찾은 승객에게 해준 조언은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What advice did Sunwoo give the passenger who hasn't found a hobby yet?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 급할 것 없이 천천히 취미를 찾으면 된다고 승객을 다독였습니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 이렇게 아무것도 안 하고 빈둥거리니까 오히려 좋다.
turns.reading: i-reo-ke a-mu-geot-do an ha-go bin-dung-geo-ri-ni-kka o-hi-ryeo jo-ta.
turns.en: Doing nothing like this and just lazing around actually feels nice.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 그자? 나도 이 시간이 제일 여유롭고 좋더라.
turns.reading: geu-ja? na-do i si-gan-i je-il yeo-yu-rop-go jo-teo-ra.
turns.en: Right? I also find this the most relaxing, best time.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 니는 맨날 비행기만 찍는데 안 질리나?
turns.reading: ni-neun maen-nal bi-haeng-gi-man jjik-neun-de an jil-li-na?
turns.en: You photograph planes every single day — don't you get sick of it?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 이게 내한테는 재충전이다. 하늘 보고 있으면 머리가 맑아진다.
turns.reading: i-ge nae-han-te-neun jae-chung-jeon-i-da. ha-neul bo-go iss-eu-myeon meo-ri-ga malg-a-jin-da.
turns.en: This is how I recharge. Looking at the sky clears my head.

dialogues.question: 선우에게 비행기 사진 찍기가 갖는 의미는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What does taking photos of planes mean to Sunwoo?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 비행기 사진을 찍는 시간이 자신에게 재충전이 되는 소중한 시간이라고 말합니다.
